# Multi-Language Dialogue Dataset for GPT-4
### A Conversation Training Resource for Cross-Lingual AI Systems
By Huggingface Hub [[source]](https://huggingface.co/datasets/shibing624/sharegpt_gpt4)
_____

### About this dataset
> This dataset provides users with an unparalleled opportunity to become acquainted with multi-language conversational AI. With conversations in four major languages -- Chinese, English, Korean and Japanese -- this robust source of data is sure to provide a building block for anyone looking to create a powerful and immersive conversational AI experience. Whether you are looking to build an enterprise chatbot that can converse fluently across multiple languages or you are merely curious about the possibilities of conversational AI, this dataset has something for everyone. Unlock the potential of real language conversations today!

### More Datasets
> For more datasets, click [here](https://www.kaggle.com/thedevastator/datasets).

### Featured Notebooks
> - 🚨 **Your notebook can be here!** 🚨! 

### How to use the dataset
> Whether you're wanting to build a multi-language conversational AI system or just want to compare and contrast different dialogue styles across languages, this dataset is perfect for you. Follow the guide below for easy tips on how to make the most out of the data: 
> 
> - Start with exploring the conversations that have been provided in each language. Take some time understanding the structure and flow of these conversations, noting any similarities or differences between them. 
> - Utilize the information from step 1 and break down your specific needs for developing your own AI system. For example, does your model need more examples of compound sentences? Will it require specifying certain lengths in conversation sentences? The answers here should come from step 1's observations about each language's dialogue style.  
> - Use this insight into subcategorize examples into custom-defined 'rules' that will define what an appropriate response would be from a conversational AI system - use more examples as necessary until you feel comfortable training such a model with the data included in this dataset! 
> - Test out various techniques and methods on synthesizing new conversations, either tuned traditionally or through deep learning models like GPT-4 which can generate novel responses easily with this comprehensive dataset!

### Research Ideas
> - Creating an AI-powered Virtual Global Interpreter that can translate between any language pair among Chinese, English, Korean and Japanese. 
> - Developing a deep learning-based multilingual dialogue system which can detect the language of conversation and respond accordingly in the right language. 
> - Building an AI multi-lingual voice assistant that can answer and respond to spoken queries in multiple languages interchangeably
